fact: On 25 June 2025 the National Director of Education launched the eSkola application, developed by Devtrust and fully integrated with SIGE, which he said is already used in all basic and secondary schools; it gives parents timetables, test calendars, marks, absences and school history, and the Ministry of Education and Devtrust signed a cooperation protocol at the launch.
title: “Damos mais um passo significativo no caminho da modernização e inclusão digital no setor da educação” – DNE
